item.text: I found a format issue: snapshot validation requires `version` to be the first JSON property, so valid saves with the same fields in another order are rejected. I’ll keep strict field validation, accept either property order, and add a versioned name field while continuing to load existing unnamed saves.

The UI now has a game-name field, and named exports carry it in snapshot format 2; older format 1 saves remain supported. I’m reviewing the changes for consistency with the existing game lifecycle and format limits.

item.text:
Added a **Game name** field. The name is included in exported version 2 snapshots and shown above the board when loaded. Existing unnamed version 1 snapshots still load.

Fixed snapshot parsing to accept valid fields in any JSON property order while still rejecting missing or extra fields. New Game and Load board clear the name; Restart keeps it.

`git diff --check` passed. I didn’t run the test suite.
